hypothesis: E25's stable lower-only policy publishes larger joint targets than ZeroActions but uses identical 8 Hz acceleration authority. A moderate post-capture strength increase will reduce actual-to-target pose error enough to establish causal recovery advantage without changing policy semantics or damping.
single_changed_variable: A multiplicative factor on Physics Control AngularStrengthMultiplier, activated only after the first active-standing policy snapshot. Angular damping ratio, extra damping, torque limit, target trajectory, observations, timing, and action values remain unchanged.

locked_configuration.action_axis: mesh-component parent-bind axis from first policy

validity_gates: All Normal first-policy and first-active snapshots are byte-identical before the factor activates.
Physics evidence records strength multiplier 1.0 at capture and the configured factor thereafter.
Damping-ratio, extra-damping, torque, targets, raw actions, and conditioned actions are unchanged across Normal arms.
Target readback ratio is 1.0 and raw streams/render are complete.
Zero guard reproduces AUC 41.14179622283463 within deterministic tolerance.
screening_success: At least one Normal arm passes all absolute criteria and recovery AUC <= 32.913436978267704.
partial_support: AUC improves monotonically but misses the threshold; use the best stable factor to screen damping separately.
falsification: Strength increase does not lower AUC or violates absolute stability.
promotion_rule: A screening winner requires a fresh complete 3+3+2 product bundle before production implementation.
next: If a factor crosses threshold, run the full bundle. Otherwise hold the best stable strength factor and screen damping ratio as a separate experiment.
